'''Blisterbugs''' were small, [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] [[Species/Legends|creatures]]. Care had to be taken when poisoned with blisterbug venom, as an [[Allergy/Legends|allergic]] reaction could cause swelling and possibly [[Death/Legends|death]]. A [[Unidentified Mandalorian (blisterbug)|Mandalorian]] once died from suffocation as he refused to remove the breastplate of his [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]], believing it was dishonorable to do so. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] veteran [[Ro-San Borokki]] wrote about the dangers of blisterbug venom in her chapter ''The Hunt'', which was published in the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]''.<ref name="BHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blisterbugs were mentioned in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' which was released on [[October 15]], [[2013]]<ref name="Release">{{InsiderCite|143|Blaster}}</ref> and written by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Ryder Windham]], and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="BHC" />
